authorization.scope: Previously reported CPU-only py310 orchestration check, shared-resource inspection, necessary input copies, result return and final documentation synchronization.

command.bash:
(
set -euo pipefail
out="reports/seller_alias_continual/20260907/text_orchestration/20260907_194523"
test -d "$out"
test ! -e "$out/check.json"
unset LD_LIBRARY_PATH LD_PRELOAD
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=""
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1
python -B scripts/step28_continual_text_run.py --help > "$out/command_help.log"
date -Is > "$out/started.txt"
set +e
/usr/bin/time -v -o "$out/resource_usage.log" nice -n 10 python -u -B scripts/step28_continual_text_run.py check --output "$out/check.json" 2>&1 | tee "$out/run.log"
statuses=("${PIPESTATUS[@]}")
set -e
printf '%s\n' "${statuses[0]}" > "$out/exit_status.txt"
printf '%s\n' "${statuses[1]}" > "$out/log_exit_status.txt"
date -Is > "$out/finished.txt"
printf 'TEXT_ORCHESTRATION_EXIT=%s LOG_EXIT=%s\n' "${statuses[0]}" "${statuses[1]}"
exit "${statuses[0]}"
)
